lines.en: I walk with a book, reading as I go.
My foot slips and the book almost falls.

lines.zh: 很久没这样走了，腿有点生。
lines.en: It's been a while since I walked like this; my legs are rusty.

lines.zh: 推了推眼镜，我继续往前。
lines.en: I push my glasses up and keep going.

lines.zh: 头顶没有电视，倒有点冷清。
lines.en: No television up there. A bit quiet.
I circle the clearing slowly.
Even a researcher needs to move around.
The wind blows; I hold the pages down.

lines.zh: 这条路我记着，以前走过。
lines.en: I remember this path. I walked it before.

lines.zh: 别催，我脚下的石头太多。
lines.en: Don't rush me; there are too many stones here.
Step by step. No hurry.

lines.zh: 身子沉了点，该多走走了。
lines.en: I've gotten heavy. I should walk more.
I sit and open the book.

lines.zh: 这一页的字，我读过十遍了。
lines.en: I've read this page ten times.
My glasses slip; I push them back up.

lines.zh: 安静，是最好的研究条件。
lines.en: Quiet is the best condition for research.

lines.zh: 我咬了咬笔杆，想不起下一句。
lines.en: I chew the pen and can't recall the next line.
"Ki" on paper isn't ki at all.
I pinch the bridge of my nose. Tired.

lines.zh: 这附近没有图书馆，可惜。
lines.en: No library nearby. A pity.
I set the bookmark and close the book.
I really don't want to fight.
The calluses on my hands are still there.
Sitting like this beats training.
The light's fading and I'm not done reading.

lines.zh: 父亲要是看见我这样，会笑。
lines.en: My father would laugh to see me like this.

lines.zh: 你挡到光了，能让一下吗？
lines.en: You're blocking my light. Could you move?
You look like you've trained.

lines.zh: 我不太擅长应付陌生人。
lines.en: I'm not very good with strangers.

lines.zh: 眼镜后面的眼睛，也在看你。
lines.en: The eyes behind these glasses are watching too.

lines.zh: 你认识我吗？我好像见过你。
lines.en: Do you know me? I think I've seen you.
Let me put the book away first.

lines.zh: 你要问什么，我知道的就答。
lines.en: Ask what you like; I'll answer what I know.

lines.zh: 别站那么近，我看不清字。
lines.en: Don't stand so close; I can't read.

lines.zh: 我站着的时候，其实很警觉。
lines.en: Standing like this, I'm actually quite alert.

lines.zh: 这本书你也会感兴趣吗？
lines.en: Would you be interested in this book?

lines.zh: 我抬手，只是想扶稳眼镜。
lines.en: My hand moves only to fix my glasses.

lines.zh: 你的气不弱，我感觉得到。
lines.en: Your ki isn't weak. I can feel it.

lines.zh: 我不是守卫，这儿也不是我的。
lines.en: I'm not a guard, and this isn't mine.
I stepped back half a pace. Pure habit.

lines.zh: 你要是不动手，我们都省事。
lines.en: If you don't attack, we both save trouble.
I look up to see you properly.

lines.zh: 这些年，我很少见到外人。
lines.en: I've rarely met outsiders these years.
Your eyes look like they're picking an opponent.

lines.zh: 眼镜飞出去了，我看不清。
lines.en: My glasses flew off; I can't see.
I should have trained a few more years.
Don't push me into Super Saiyan.
I brace a knee and catch my breath.
The book is still against my chest. Not dropped.
I back off a few paces and reset my stance.
Age doesn't spare anyone.
Blood dripped on a page. Shame.

lines.zh: 我咬着牙，没有出声，气还在聚。
lines.en: I grit my teeth in silence and gather ki.

lines.zh: 学者的身体，也挨得住这拳。
lines.en: Even a scholar's body can take that punch.
A snack? I did skip lunch.
Leave it there; I'll eat in a bit.
Not done reading. One bite first.
This tastes like home cooking.

lines.zh: 我手上还有墨，别弄脏了。
lines.en: There's ink on my hands; don't let it stain.

lines.zh: 你给得这么爽快，我有点疑心。
lines.en: You give it so readily, I'm a little suspicious.

lines.zh: 研究员也是要补充体力的。
lines.en: Researchers need to keep their strength up too.
I'll pocket it and eat later.
It's not enough, but thank you.

lines.zh: 我伸手之前，先看了看你。
lines.en: Before reaching, I check your face.
I flew too fast and clipped you with my shoulder.
The book fell. Help me get it?

lines.zh: 你撞过来的时候，我退了。
lines.en: You came at me and I gave ground.
This body of mine is in the way, isn't it.
My glasses are crooked. Fixing them is all.

lines.zh: 我们肩膀撞了一下，都不重。
lines.en: We clipped shoulders. Neither of us hard.
Don't push; my hands are full.
Steady yourself; the ground is slick here.
We collided and the pages scattered.
Let me by. I'm heading through.
I'm not good at saying things like this.
Sit down first; standing is tiring.
I've closed the book. Go ahead.
All these years, I've been alone.

lines.zh: 你愿意听我讲点旧事吗？
lines.en: Would you listen to some old stories?

lines.zh: 家里就我和女儿两个人。
lines.en: At home it's just me and my daughter.
My hands are clumsy. Don't mind them.

lines.zh: 眼镜摘下来，我什么都看不清。
lines.en: Take my glasses off and I can't see a thing.
Just sitting here. That's nice.

lines.zh: 你别走，我还想再说几句。
lines.en: Don't go yet. I have more to say.
I pick it up and blow off the dust.
That's a page of my book. Thank you.
I'll press it into the book so it isn't lost.

lines.zh: 这石头形状不错，像样本。
lines.en: A nice shape — could be a sample.

lines.zh: 我拿着它，忘了要做什么。
lines.en: I'm holding it and forgot what for.
Too heavy; I use both hands.
On the table for now; I'll sort it later.
Found this — whose is it, I wonder.
I wipe it on my sleeve and put it away.

lines.zh: 这枚小东西，值得记下来。
lines.en: A little thing worth noting down.

lines.zh: 你刚才那一下，是认真的？
lines.en: That last move — were you serious?
I've put the book down.
The look behind my glasses has changed.
I wanted to avoid this.
Your killing intent isn't well hidden.
It's been so long, my hands may be rusty.
I've straightened up. You can tell.
A moment ago I was still reading.
If that's how it is, I'll spar with you.
My ki rises. It feels unfamiliar.
Push me and I have to answer.

lines.zh: 这一带没什么可毁的，还好。
lines.en: Not much here to destroy. That's a relief.
One step forward — just positioning.
What my father taught me, the body still remembers.
You moved first. Remember that.
All right. Don't say I didn't warn you.
I'm watching where your weight sits.
Your left shoulder dropped — you're about to strike.
I won't rush; I'll look first.

lines.zh: 这些年的研究，也没白做。
lines.en: All those years of study weren't wasted.
Your breathing is shallower than before.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，把距离拉开。
lines.en: I take half a step back to open the distance.
I should take the glasses off first.

lines.zh: 我抬手扶了扶镜框，你紧张了。
lines.en: I adjust my frames and you tense up.
Which side will you come from?

lines.zh: 我们这样站着，也算交手。
lines.en: Standing like this counts as crossing blades.
Not yet — I'm not warmed up.
The ground is uneven. That favors you.
Your steps are light. You've trained.

lines.zh: 蓄气三秒，够我冲到你面前。
lines.en: Three seconds of charge is enough to reach you.
You keep closing in. I don't like it.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，不看眼睛。
lines.en: I watch your hands, not your eyes.
I think I've seen this stance before.
One more second and you'll have to move first.
A straight punch. Nothing fancy.
One step in, strike, step out.
The form is rusty; the force remains.
I block with an elbow and add one back.
This kick won't win any beauty contests.
I clamp your wrist.
I stop here.
My fist lands and my hand goes numb.
I sweep at your leg — stay on your feet.
At this range, the elbow.
My strikes are light. Don't misunderstand.
The body remembers faster than the mind.
One hit. That's enough.

lines.zh: 我把你推回去，别再过来。
lines.en: I push you back. Don't come again.

lines.zh: 这一拳，是为了让你冷静。
lines.en: This punch is to cool you down.
I'm breathing harder than I'd like.
I close the book and stand up.
This is roomier than my study.
Glasses cleaned. I can see clearly.
I'm here, though not very willingly.
Soil underfoot, not a lectern.
All this strength, unused for so long.
I roll up my sleeves.

lines.zh: 别指望我一开始就用全力。
lines.en: Don't expect full power from the start.
Nice weather for a walk.

lines.zh: 任务写着我的名字，我到了。
lines.en: The mission bears my name; I have arrived.
I plant my feet and take in the surroundings.

lines.zh: 书上写的，跟眼前差很远。
lines.en: What's in the book is far from what's here.

lines.zh: 我叹了口气，把书递给空气。
lines.en: I sigh and hand the book to no one.

lines.zh: 这一趟，本来只想找点资料。
lines.en: I only came looking for material.
My ki is unsteady. I'm adjusting.

lines.zh: 我看看脚下，确定站得稳。
lines.en: I check my footing, making sure it's solid.
So it comes to blows. What a nuisance.

lines.zh: 我抬手，摆了个很旧的起手式。
lines.en: I raise my hands into a very old stance.

lines.zh: 我推了推眼镜，气已经在手心。
lines.en: I push up my glasses; ki is already in my palm.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下来，浑身是土。
lines.en: I rolled down the slope, covered in dirt.

lines.zh: 呛了一口水，眼镜也湿了。
lines.en: I swallowed water and my glasses are soaked.
The blast tore the pages away.
Something sank deep into my shoulder.
This power isn't in any book.

lines.zh: 太久没吃东西，手都在抖。
lines.en: Too long without food; my hands shake.

lines.zh: 再挨几下，我就得变身了。
lines.en: A few more hits and I will transform.
There's nowhere to put my feet here.
